newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Applied '98 EPS view raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Applied '98 EPS view raised.

text.p: --Barrington Research Associates Inc said Thursday it raised its earnings per share estimate on Applied Industrial Technologies Inc to $2.63 from $2.42 for FY98 (June) based on the company's completing in May it pending $83 million acquisition of Invetech Co.
--Barrington Research left its FY97 estimate unchanged at $2.20.
--It maintained its 1-Buy rating on the stock.
--Applied Industrial Technology's ended trade up 1/8 at 30-7/8.
